apps.name: crew-manager
apps.note: Cross-session work overview (Needs you / Running / Done) with a private Conductor panel; public repo.

apps.name: endless-worlds
apps.note: AI-narrated life simulator; public repo, individual author. Ships three app agents plus an MCP server, and its onInstall step installs optional art dependencies.

apps.name: todo-txt
apps.note: Plain-text todo.txt manager over a local file; public repo, individual author. Backend and UI only, no skills and no install hooks.

apps.name: dynatrace
apps.note: Dynatrace (dynatrace-oss); public repo, Apache-2.0, CODEOWNERS + SUPPORT.md present. Read-only app: dtctl queries only, changes no Dynatrace state. Ships a Python backend and a 15-minute smart-rank cron, so it needs agent.apps_allow_third_party.

apps.name: file-review
apps.note: Individual author; public repo, MIT, pinned to the v1.1.0 tag. NOT read-only: edits and writes files on the gateway host (credential paths refused on every route by the gateway's own fence) and registers in-gateway Python routes, so it needs a trust grant. No cron, no MCP.

apps.name: html-studio
apps.note: Community app by an individual author; public repo, Apache-2.0. View, edit, check and present HTML slide decks beside the agent that writes them. Pinned to a release-v<version> branch commit, which carries the built UI (main is sources only). Python stdlib backend, one skill, no cron.

apps.name: aidlc-studio
apps.note: Individual author; public repo, Apache-2.0, pinned to v1.0.1; bundles MIT-0 AI-DLC Workflows 2.7.1. NOT read-only: installs that harness into repos the owner registers and relays the owner's confirmed gate decisions to the intent's chat; needs a trust grant. No git writes, network, cron or MCP.

apps.name: mood-music
apps.note: Mood-matched songs in Crew browser (YouTube/bilibili); page shows buddy's browser. Buddy chat hidden, in Crew memory. Individual author. Backend, song-end hook, UI, 1 agent, 1 skill. Asks sessionApproval, hiddenSessions, chatSlots, browserSites, browser:view. Needs KiroCrew#39018, #39943, #40261.

apps.name: crew-calendar
apps.note: Individual author; public repo, MIT. The release tag includes a prebuilt UI and Universal macOS helper. Python routes and MCP server require app trust. Apple Calendar writes require native confirmation. No cron.
